label: selling-agent-buyer_console
request_preview: Hi — I need 3 electric kettles for our office pantry. What can you do on price for three?

json.message: We can certainly help equip your office pantry. For an order of 3 of our 1L kettles, I can offer an 8% discount on the batch, bringing the total to ₹13,772. Would you also be interested in adding a toaster or blender to round out the pantry setup at a bundle rate?
json.rationale: Opened negotiations at an 8% discount for a 3-unit volume order while leaving room to move towards our 15% ceiling and attempting to cross-sell pantry items.
